files.Title: FFmpeg.Audio.AudioBuffer
files.Summary: Represents an audio buffer that manages audio data in various formats and provides methods for manipulating and accessing the buffer.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Audio.AudioFifo
files.Summary: Represents a managed wrapper around FFmpeg's AVAudioFifo for audio buffering.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Audio.AudioServiceType
files.Summary: Specifies the type of audio service or channel. These values are used to indicate the purpose of the audio track in various multimedia applications.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Audio.ChannelLayout
files.Summary: Represents a channel layout, which defines the arrangement of audio channels in a multi-channel audio format. This class provides functionality to interact with and manipulate audio channel layouts using FFmpeg's structure.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Audio.ChannelLayoutConstList
files.Summary: Represents a read-only list of instances.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Audio.ChannelLayout_ref
files.Summary: Represents a reference to an FFmpeg structure.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Audio.IChannelLayout
files.Summary: Defines an interface for working with channel layouts in audio processing.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Audio.SampleExtensions
files.Summary: Provides extension methods for working with values.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Audio.SampleFormat
files.Summary: Defines the audio sample formats used for encoding and decoding audio data.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Audio.SwrContext
files.Summary: Represents a managed wrapper for the FFmpeg SwrContext, used for audio resampling, format conversion, and channel layout remapping.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.Codec
files.Summary: Represents a codec in FFmpeg, providing access to its core information such as name, capabilities, supported formats, and additional metadata. This struct allows interaction with codec details in a managed, type-safe manner.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.CodecCapabilities
files.Summary: Flags representing the capabilities of codecs in FFmpeg. These capabilities describe various features or behaviors that a codec can support, such as multi-threading, handling frame sizes, and experimental features.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.CodecContext
files.Summary:
Represents a codec context used for encoding or decoding video and audio streams using FFmpeg.

This class wraps the structure from the FFmpeg library, providing an interface for configuring and interacting with codec parameters for both encoding and decoding operations.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.CodecDescription
files.Summary:
Represents a codec descriptor with various properties.

This struct is a readonly wrapper around an pointer, providing a way to access codec descriptor properties in a safe manner.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.CodecFlags
files.Summary: Represents various codec flags used to control the behavior of codecs in FFmpeg.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.CodecID
files.Summary: Identify the syntax and semantics of the bitstream. The principle is roughly: Two decoders with the same ID can decode the same streams. Two encoders with the same ID can encode compatible streams. There may be slight deviations from the principle due to implementation details.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.CodecParameters
files.Summary: A managed wrapper around the unmanaged FFmpeg _AVCodecParameters structure, providing safe access to codec parameters.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.CodecParameters_ref
files.Summary: A managed wrapper around the unmanaged FFmpeg _AVCodecParameters structure, providing safe access to codec parameters.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.CodecProperties
files.Summary: Enum representing codec properties (a combination of flags).

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.CodecTag
files.Summary: Represents a codec tag, combining a codec ID and a FourCC (Four Character Code) tag.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.DecodeErrorFlags
files.Summary: Flags representing various decode errors.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.IAudioDecoder
files.Summary: Represents an audio decoder providing access to various properties of the audio stream being decoded.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.IAudioEncoder
files.Summary: Represents an interface for audio encoders, providing properties specific to audio encoding such as sample rate, format, and channel layout. Inherits from for general encoding options.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.ICodecParameters
files.Summary: Defines an interface for accessing and modifying codec parameters, including audio, video, and general stream properties.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.IEncoderContext
files.Summary: Represents the context for encoding operations, including codec information and encoding settings. This interface manages encoding state and allows querying and setting options for the encoder.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.IVideoDecoder
files.Summary: Defines the interface for a video decoder, which is responsible for decoding video streams.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.IVideoEncoder
files.Summary: Represents an interface for video encoders, providing properties specific to video encoding such as frame rate, resolution, and pixel format. Inherits from for general encoding options.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.Profile
files.Summary: Represents a profile in FFmpeg, providing information about the profile ID and its associated name.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.Video.LibSVTAV1.BitrateControl.AdaptiveQuantization
files.Summary: Defines the available adaptive quantization modes.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.Video.LibSVTAV1.BitrateControl.BitrateControlMode
files.Summary: Defines the available bitrate control modes.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.Video.LibSVTAV1.BitrateControl
files.Summary: Represents the bitrate control settings for the SVT-AV1 encoder. Provides configuration options for different bitrate control modes and adaptive quantization.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.Video.LibSVTAV1.GOPSettings
files.Summary: Represents the Group of Pictures (GOP) settings, controlling the interval between keyframes in video encoding.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.Video.LibSVTAV1.ScreenContentMode
files.Summary: Specifies the mode for handling screen content in the SVT-AV1 encoder. Screen content refers to video content that primarily consists of static images, text, or graphical elements (such as computer-generated content).

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.Video.LibSVTAV1.TuningMetric
files.Summary: Specifies the metric used for tuning the encoding process to optimize quality or performance.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.Video.SVTAV1
files.Summary: Represents the SVT-AV1 video codec.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Codecs.Video.VideoCodec
files.Summary: Represents a base class for configuring and creating video codec contexts. This abstract class provides common functionality for different video codecs.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Collections.AVBuffer
files.Summary: Represents a wrapper for an AVBufferRef in FFmpeg, which manages reference-counted buffers. Provides functionality for managing the lifetime, access, and manipulation of these buffers.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Collections.AVBufferPool
files.Summary: Represents a pool of objects for efficient memory management.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Collections.AVBuffer_ref
files.Summary: Represents a reference to an AVBuffer, providing a set of operations for handling buffer memory and metadata in a safe manner, while leveraging the underlying AVBufferRef structure.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Collections.AVDictionary
files.Summary: Represents a dictionary that wraps around the FFmpeg AVDictionary structure.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Collections.AVDictionary_ref
files.Summary: Represents a dictionary that wraps around the FFmpeg AVDictionary structure, allowing for key-value pair management with additional features such as case-insensitive comparisons.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Collections.AVMultiDictionary
files.Summary: Represents a multi-dictionary that allows multiple values for a single key.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Collections.AVMultiDictionary_ref
files.Summary: Represents a multi-dictionary that allows multiple values for a single key.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Collections.IBuffer
files.Summary: Defines the interface for buffer management, providing methods for accessing and manipulating data, managing reference counts, and handling buffer memory operations.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Exceptions.FFmpegException
files.Summary: Represents errors that occur during FFmpeg operations.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Exceptions.OptionNotFoundException
files.Summary: Represents an exception that is thrown when an option is not found in an FFmpeg operation.

files.Title: FFmpeg.FFmpegLoader
files.Summary: Used to initialize the ffmpeg bindings

files.Title: FFmpeg.Filters.BufferSrcParameters
files.Summary: Represents the parameters used for configuring a buffer source in FFmpeg. Provides mechanisms to allocate, manage, and dispose of buffer source parameters.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Filters.Filter
files.Summary: Represents a filter used in FFmpeg's filter graph. Provides information about filters, including their names, descriptions, inputs, outputs, and flags.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Filters.FilterContext
files.Summary: Represents a filter context in FFmpeg, which is used to manage filter instances in a filter graph.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Filters.FilterFlags
files.Summary: Represents various filter flags used in FFmpeg filters. These flags indicate different capabilities or behaviors of the filters.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Filters.FilterGraph
files.Summary: Represents an FFmpeg filter graph, which contains multiple filter contexts and manages their connections.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Filters.FilterPad
files.Summary: Represents a single filter pad, which is used for connecting filter inputs and outputs in an FFmpeg filter graph.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Filters.FilterPadList
files.Summary: Represents a read-only list of objects, providing access to the pads in a filter.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Formats.AVStream
files.Summary: Managed wrapper for the FFmpeg AVStream structure.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Formats.DiscardFlags
files.Summary: Flags to specify the discard behavior for frames during processing.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Formats.FormatContext
files.Summary: Provides a managed wrapper around the native structure from the FFmpeg library.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Formats.FormatContextFlags
files.Summary: Flags that specify the characteristics of a format context in FFmpeg. These flags provide information about the presence of headers and the seekability of the stream.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Formats.FormatFlags
files.Summary: Flags used to specify various format options.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Formats.InputFormat
files.Summary: Represents an AV input format, wrapping around an pointer.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Formats.OutputFormat
files.Summary: Represents an output format in the FFmpeg library.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Formats.StreamDisposition
files.Summary: Enum representing the stream disposition flags, indicating special properties of a stream.

files.Title: FFmpeg.HW.CodecHWConfig
files.Summary: Represents a hardware configuration for a codec, wrapping around the FFmpeg _AVCodecHWConfig structure.

files.Title: FFmpeg.HW.CodecHWConfigMethod
files.Summary: Enum representing the hardware configuration methods supported by the codec.

files.Title: FFmpeg.HW.DeviceContext
files.Summary: Represents a hardware device context in FFmpeg, encapsulating the buffer reference for hardware acceleration.

files.Title: FFmpeg.HW.DeviceContext_ref
files.Summary: Represents a pointer to an FFmpeg hardware device context buffer reference. This is used to manage hardware-accelerated contexts in FFmpeg.

files.Title: FFmpeg.HW.DeviceType
files.Summary: Specifies the hardware device types available for multimedia acceleration in FFmpeg.

files.Title: FFmpeg.HW.FramesContext
files.Summary: Represents a hardware device context in FFmpeg, encapsulating the buffer reference for hardware acceleration.

files.Title: FFmpeg.HW.FramesContext_ref
files.Summary: Represents a pointer to an FFmpeg hardware device context buffer reference. This is used to manage hardware-accelerated contexts in FFmpeg.

files.Title: FFmpeg.IO.AVIOContext
files.Summary: Represents a managed wrapper for the unmanaged FFmpeg AVIOContext structure. This class provides access to various properties and methods related to AVIOContext.

files.Title: FFmpeg.IO.AVSeek
files.Summary: Flags used for seeking operations within a stream or file in FFmpeg. These flags can be combined using a bitwise OR to modify the behavior of seeking functions.

files.Title: FFmpeg.IO.IOContext
files.Summary: Represents an abstract base class for handling custom I/O operations in FFmpeg. This class encapsulates an FFmpeg AVIOContext and manages its lifecycle and memory management.

files.Title: FFmpeg.IO.IOOptions
files.Summary: Flags representing different input/output operations that can be performed on a stream or file. These flags can be combined using a bitwise OR, except for and , which are mutually exclusive.

files.Title: FFmpeg.IO.IOStreamContext
files.Summary: Represents an I/O context for interacting with a .NET object. This class supports reading from, writing to, and seeking within the stream.

files.Title: FFmpeg.IO.Protocols
files.Summary: Provides access to the input and output protocols supported by FFmpeg for internal URL IO operations.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.ChromaLocation
files.Summary: Specifies the location of chroma samples in the video.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.ColorPrimaries
files.Summary: Represents the chromaticity coordinates of the source primaries, matching values defined by ISO/IEC 23091-2_2019 and ITU-T H.273.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.ColorRange
files.Summary: Represents the visual content value range.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.ColorSpace
files.Summary: Represents various color space types. These values are based on ISO/IEC 23091-2_2019 subclause 8.3.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.ColorTransferCharacteristic
files.Summary: Represents the color transfer characteristics, which define how color values are encoded and transformed. These values match the ones defined by ISO/IEC 23091-2_2019 subclause 8.2.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.FFLoss
files.Summary: Represents different types of data loss in video compression as flags. These values are defined in the FFmpeg library (ffmpeg.FF_LOSS_*).

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.FieldOrder
files.Summary: Specifies the field order of interlaced video. These values match the ones defined by various video standards.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.Image
files.Summary: Represents an image stored in consecutive memory with utilities for handling image data and memory buffers.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.ImageInfo
files.Summary: Represents image metadata including width, height, pixel format, and memory alignment.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.PixelFormat
files.Summary: Represents the various pixel formats available.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.SwsAlgorithm
files.Summary: Represents a scaling algorithm for use with FFmpeg's libswscale, encapsulating the algorithm flags and optional scaling parameters. These parameters can tune the behavior of the scaling algorithm for finer control over image scaling quality.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.SwsContext
files.Summary: Represents a context for scaling and converting image frames between different sizes and pixel formats. This class provides an interface for configuring the source and destination image properties and performing the conversion using the FFmpeg scaling library.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Images.SwsFlags
files.Summary: Represents the various flags and scaling algorithms used in FFmpeg's libswscale for sws_getContext.

files.Title: FFmpeg.MediaSource
files.Summary: Represents a media source that handles reading and decoding of media data from various input sources.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Metadata.MetadataTag
files.Summary: Enum representing metadata tags used in the FFmpeg library.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Metadata.MetadataTags
files.Summary: Contains constant string values for metadata tags used in the FFmpeg library.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Options.IOptionQuery
files.Summary: Defines methods for querying and setting options in a system. Provides functionality to find, retrieve, and modify various types of options using either or option names.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Options.Option
files.Summary: Represents an option in the FFmpeg library's configuration system.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Options.OptionFlags
files.Summary: Represents the flags that can be applied to AVOptions in FFmpeg. These flags control how options are used during encoding, decoding, filtering, and other operations.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Options.OptionQueryBase
files.Summary: An abstract base class for querying options from AV-option-enabled classes.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Options.OptionType
files.Summary: Represents the different types of options available in the FFmpeg library.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Subtitles.Subtitle
files.Summary: Represents a collection of subtitle rectangles and manages subtitle display timings. This class wraps an FFmpeg structure and provides access to subtitle properties and rectangles.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Subtitles.SubtitleRect
files.Summary: Represents a rectangular subtitle area and its associated metadata, such as position, size, color count, and text or bitmap data. This struct wraps an pointer from FFmpeg.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Subtitles.SubtitleType
files.Summary: Represents the type of subtitle, which defines how the subtitle data is structured or formatted.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.AVFrame
files.Summary:
Represents a decoded audio or video frame in memory. This structure holds raw data for video frames or audio samples.
It provides methods and properties to access and manipulate this data, as well as to manage the associated resources.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.AVPacket
files.Summary: Managed wrapper for the FFmpeg structure. Provides managed access to packet data, timestamps, and operations for video and audio streaming.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.AVPacket_ref
files.Summary: Managed wrapper for the FFmpeg structure. Provides managed access to packet data, timestamps, and operations for video and audio streaming.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.AVResult32
files.Summary: Represents a 32-bit integer result from an AV operation.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.AVResult64
files.Summary: Represents a 64-bit integer result from an AV operation.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.EightCC
files.Summary: Represents an EightCC (eight-character code), which is a sequence of eight 8-bit characters packed into a 64-bit unsigned integer.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.FrameFlags
files.Summary: Specifies flags for frames in FFmpeg.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.IPacket
files.Summary: Managed wrapper for the FFmpeg structure. Provides managed access to packet data, timestamps, and operations for video and audio streaming.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.IReference<T>
files.Summary: Represents an interface for managing references to unmanaged objects that must be disposed, such as FFmpeg objects, without requiring the implementing struct to handle disposal directly.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.MediaType
files.Summary: Represents different types of media streams. Mapped from FFmpeg.AutoGen._AVMediaType enum.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.PacketFlags
files.Summary: Enumeration for packet flags, corresponding to AV_PKT_FLAG values.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.PictureType
files.Summary: Specifies different types of picture frames used in video coding standards.

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.Quality
files.Summary: Represents quality from 1 (BEST) to FF_LAMBDA_MAX (WORST).

files.Title: FFmpeg.Utils.Rational
files.Summary: Represents a rational number with a numerator and denominator. This struct is readonly for performance reasons.
